entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Servílio Sebastião de Oliveira is a former Brazilian Olympic bronze medalist. In 1968, he became the first Brazilian boxer ever to win an Olympic medal. It occurred at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City. An eye injury forced his retirement from professional boxing. He made a comeback and won two bouts in 1977, then re-retired with a record of 19–0.

It occurred at the 1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City. An eye injury forced his retirement from professional boxing.
